notes.title: Critical Compendium 1.0.9
notes.content:
Lots of fixes this time around:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with dark borders on character sheet input fields.
[*] Added multi spellbook support to the character sheet.
[*] Fixed issues with populating a couple fields on the character sheet.
[*] Fixed issue with the logo on the character sheet.
[*] Fixed issue with item rarity not always correct.
[*] Added support for Artifact rarity.
[*] UI improvements for features and equipped items.
[*] Fixed an issue with attuned items not always updating.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
That's all for now guys, hope you enjoy the updates!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/critical-version-30641871]View the official announcement.[/url]

notes.title: Critical Compendium Version 1.0.8 (5e)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Sorry for the delay between updates - just been busy with work and life. But I have lots good changes this time around!

Features:
[list]
[*] Bags now have an option to add all items from equipment packs. Special thanks to patron Jean-Claude Frigon for this suggestion!
[*] Added counters to the character sheet export.
[*] Added a tooltip to the experience bar that shows xp needed to level up.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with equipped items not updating.
[*] Fixed a spell slot issue when leveling up.
[*] Fixed an issue with the character tile level display not updating on level up.
[*] Fixed an issue with modal dialog titles.
[*] Fixed duplicate attack damage type when exporting character sheet.
[/list]

As always, more updates are coming soon!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/critical-version-29395527]View the official announcement.[/url]

notes.title: Critical Compendium Version 1.0.3 (5e)
notes.content:
Another day, another round of updates and fixes. Version 1.03 includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed issue with feats and features not refreshing after leveling up.
[*] Fixed AC being auto-calculated when it shouldn't.
[*] Minor updates to UI/UX.
[*] Improved character PDF export.
[*] Fixed inconsistency in the order of character information and additions.
[*] Fixed encounter copy issue.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who reported these issues!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/critical-version-27636277]View the official announcement.[/url]

notes.title: Critical Compendium Version 1.0.2 (5e)
notes.content:
I know what you're thinking,

[i]"Whoa! Two updates in one day? You must've found some moderately embarrassing bugs and wanted to fix that junk right away!"[/i]

And you'd be exactly right. Fixes include:

[list]
[*] Long rest was crashing when you have a spellbook based on race.
[*] Attempting to add an invocation to your spellbook would cause a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue with downloading steam cloud saves between computers.
[/list]

Sorry about these issues guys! Hopefully this unblocks some of you so you can get back to adventuring.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/critical-version-27616246]View the official announcement[/url]

notes.title: Critical Compendium Version 1.0.1 (5e)
notes.content:
Version 1.01 is now live! This version includes the following bug fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] UI/UX improvements to for alerts and dialogs.
[*] Improved default import behavior.
[*] Fixed a crash when attempting to import invalid files.
[*] Fixed a couple bugs when restoring the default compendium.
[*] Updates to the default SRD compendium.
[*] Fixed an issue with movement speed changes not saving.
[/list]

Thanks for using Critical Compendium and I hope you enjoy the latest version!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/critical-version-27613350]View the official announcement[/url]
